rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_shared_prefix_boundary.go: reads the request-context token offset where the rendered leading system/tools block ends, set by Complete after preparePrompt, so prefill can admit a complete snapshot there for sibling fan-out requests on recurrent hybrids.
rows.distinction: A per-request snapshot-placement HINT read from context - NOT the radix structural match (cacheable) and NOT the adaptive divergence/grid checkpoint (inKernelAdaptiveSnapshotCheckpoint).

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_shared_prefix_boundary.go: returns the ascending, de-duplicated prompt offsets (shared boundary plus adaptive checkpoint) strictly between the restored prefix and the prompt end at which prefill admits complete snapshots.
rows.distinction: The ordered SET of offsets for one prefill - NOT inKernelAdaptiveSnapshotCheckpoint (the single divergence/grid offset it includes).

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_decode.go: the single snapshot offset at the structural divergence point when it lies inside the prompt, else the deepest 64-token grid boundary strictly before the prompt end.
rows.distinction: ONE offset derived from the radix match - NOT the shared system/tools boundary hint and NOT the full prompt snapshot.

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_host_snapshot_reuse.go: true on the host-session (no compute.Backend) seam for a Qwen3.5 recurrent hybrid or a qualified V4.1 host route, where a complete PrefixSnapshot is the only restorable prefix boundary.
rows.distinction: A route PREDICATE selecting the snapshot tier - NOT inKernelPlannerPrefixReuseSupported (whether prefix reuse is enabled at all).
